proposed_capability: P95 call-stack prototype: explicitly activated host listener accepts provider-supplied semantic tooltip hover transitions and linked action/outcome events; bounded 3/5/10/30/60-minute windows emit evidence-qualified machine-readable behavior evaluation. No implicit OS hooks, daemon, raw tooltip text, click authority or unreviewed policy training.
player_save_control_impact: Explicit active-session, read-only adapter; player activity may be observed for context but never intercepted, replayed or interrupted. No saves, SendInput, screen takeover or passive desktop telemetry. Raw tooltip text, personal data, and screenshots are forbidden.
expected_outcome: Event edge detection, source/target/interaction association, bounded rolling windows (180/300/600/1800/3600 seconds), observed versus reviewed outcome evaluation, safe abstention and an opt-in CLI surface that supports real future calibrated sensors.
negative_tests: Repeated tooltip-visible polls do not duplicate hover events
Different target cannot inherit an action success
Outcome cannot be counted without matched action and reviewed evidence
Unknown or missing scene/patch -> observational only
Out-of-order time, unbounded events, malformed reference, arbitrary tooltip contents -> reject
All windows use event-time cutoffs, not lifetime totals
No game control or implicit auto-training
rollback_path: Revert feature PR; existing host listener state and judgments remain untouched. Runtime sidecar data only under ignored dist/host-listener/<session>.
unresolved_unknowns: Actual Sims 4 hover tooltip sensor, localization, timing and provenance need local calibrated game observations
Observed success labels still require operator review and independent after-state evidence to train models
